verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a government business-filing portal could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring filings, or an API that users automate against. The evidence shows no such capability. Filings are manual online, mail or in-person submissions; no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was found; the bizfile portal sits behind a bot-management shell; and from August 1, 2026, online Statement of Information filings will require entity-linked User Access accounts. The ballot-tracking notification is a voter alert, not a user-configured background automation.
